Rooted on Main Street.
Made for good evenings.

Greenville, Illinois

Modern dining. Old-fashioned soul.

In the heart of Greenville, Grouchy's Public House brings together premium grilled dishes, handcrafted cocktails, whiskey, bourbon and craft beer in a warm, intimate setting.

Come for dinner, stay for another round, and settle into a place made for date nights, celebrations and good company.

Charcoal · Oak · Open flame

Crafted over fire.

Everything worth charring goes over live flame — cuts seasoned simply, cooked hard, rested properly.

The house

From the grill
Steaks, chops and burgers over charcoal and open flame — seasoned simply, cooked hard, rested properly.
Behind the bar
Whiskey and bourbon chosen one bottle at a time, Jack Daniel's and curated flights, craft beer on draft, and classic cocktails made the slow way.
In the room
Dark wood, deep booths and pendant light. Open 5 days a week for lunch and dinner at 305 W Main St.
